visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed themed hero (leafgreen by default) with a sliding track of slides, prev/next controls shown on hover on desktop and pagination bullets.

contentPattern.structure: mobile image (square), optional desktop image (wide), then heading (h1 on the first slide, h2 after), text and a CTA link

usage: Top-of-page hero carousel on landing pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for a landing-page hero with one or more slides; for a single title band use page-lead.
